name: secret-and-config-exposure-in-pipeline-auditor
description: Audits pipeline configs, variables, and repository settings for exposed secrets, plaintext credentials, and missing secret-scanning across GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps. Read-only; references any suspected secret by identifier only, never by value. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (a custom source-control/CI MCP and the AWS Documentation MCP Server for hardening guidance) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 07:00 UTC
